prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Test Screen: Adds a dedicated desktop pet visibility verification screen after home intro to ensure the pet renders properly on the user's screen. (why: Support received 3 complaints about pets not showing on the desktop or the app failing to open, and the finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Recovery Notice: Displays an account sync reassurance hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users that their pets will restore. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Selector Redesign: Replaces standard path selection layout with a story_scroll format with preview cards. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating substantial user hesitation.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Controls Checklist Screen: Adds an interactive checklist screen at the end of onboarding detailing shortcuts and mouse controls. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling/hiding pets and 4 emails regarding desktop feature misbehavior.)
4: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Ambient Sound and Stage Flow: Transforms the waiting screen into an ambient stage layout with calm sound and smooth visual progress indicators. (why: The home waiting screen has a massive mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing high drop-offs prior to completion.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Status Connection Badge: Adds a network status badge and explicit system connectivity confirmation to the sign-in screen. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen not appearing or the app stalling right before sign-in.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Spotlight Demo Video: Upgrades the story screen to a spotlight layout featuring an animated preview video of pets in action. (why: Initial conversion from story to path selection is only 76.2% with a long mean time.)
